retro-office.about: Muted, foggy, symmetrical AI stills: 1980s-90s offices, CRT screens, lone humanoid robots, institutional teal-grey and beige, cool fluorescent light. The look of the 'AI take over backfired' essay.
retro-office.prompt: Cinematic still, 16:9. Retro-futuristic corporate dystopia in muted institutional tones (teal-grey #4B5E5B, beige-grey #9EA292, charcoal #1C2523, cyan CRT glow #67B7C7). Symmetrical eye-level composition, lots of empty space, 1990s offices and public buildings, cool overhead fluorescents, soft atmospheric haze, light halation, fine 35mm film grain, desaturated, quiet and eerie documentary mood. Smooth white humanoid robots with dark joints where people would be. No text, no logos, no watermarks.

archive-noir.about: Black-and-white archival look for history and economics essays: old photographs, newsrooms, factories, crowds.
archive-noir.prompt: Cinematic black-and-white archival photograph, 16:9, mid-20th-century documentary look, deep shadows, soft grain, slight vignette, symmetrical framing, quiet and serious mood. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
